text:
jen_partnerships: quick check-in 15m: VaultStream (SI) wants a joint MSSP listing bundling Redwood Private + VaultStream secrets. asks: SAML SSO example, SCIM provisioning sample, and KMS/HSM key-wrap demo. Partner marketing needs a short runbook + smoke script by EOW. @samir_eng @lee_security can we commit?

samir_eng: I can run the smoke. need to clarify KMS scope  is it symmetric key-wrap for rotation or HSM signing?

jen_partnerships: they called it key-wrap for rotating secrets-at-rest (wrap/unwrap). also want sample SAML assertion and SCIM group sync. deadline is tight  webinar next week.

lee_security: treat as BYOK for Private. confirm VaultStream's KMS vendor (KeyWave?) and whether they support KMIP. add short threat-model about cross-tenant key access. no real certs in docs.

olivia_sales: VaultStream will provide a dev tenant and a non-prod KMIP endpoint with test certs. they'll also want an integration checklist to prep service accounts and roles.

samir_eng: plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) SCIM token + incremental group sync, 3) KMIP key-wrap handshake, 4) call Redwood rotate API to verify rotation. I'll post minimal examples.

samir_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.vaultstream.example/scim/token \
  -d '{"client_id":"vault-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

samir_eng: rotate example (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"vs-demo","kms_key_id":"kmip://test-key"}'
```

deploy-bot: CI #vaultstream-integ smoke run finished  6 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM paging). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/5678 :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: SCIM paging caused timeout on larger groups. switching to incremental sync + exponential backoff and idempotency header.

lee_security: include idempotency token for provisioning calls, CA thumbprint validation for KMIP endpoint, and rollback: revert to previous wrapping key + mark secrets read-only if rotation fails. add note: avoid long-lived provisioning tokens.

maria_pm: I can draft the 1-pager + 4-slide deck if eng gives commands/screenshots by Wed.

jen_partnerships: action items: Samir  E2E smoke + scripts (Tue EOD); Maria  runbook + slides (Wed EOD); Olivia  partner dev tenant & test certs (Wed AM); Lee  security notes + threat-model snippet (Wed EOD). Marketing needs final assets Thu for co-announce.

olivia_sales: nudging VaultStream now for certs and service-account details.

samir_eng: sharing temp repo: https://git.internal/redwood/vaultstream-integ (internal only). will sanitize before external share.

jen_partnerships: perfect  we'll consolidate and iterate. thanks team :rocket:
